blocks.title: Beef tacos
steps: Brown the beef in a little oil, drain, stir in the seasoning mix and 2/3 cup water.
Simmer 5 minutes while you shred the lettuce and dice the tomatoes.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan.
Fill with beef and cheese; top with lettuce, tomato, salsa and sour cream.
